highlights.title: Better Mini App icons
highlights.description: Mini App icons now load only when needed and are saved for faster access later, improving privacy and performance.

highlights.title: Cleaner in-app browsing
highlights.description: Fixed extra spacing that could appear while viewing content inside Nimiq Pay.

highlights.title: Clearer wording
highlights.description: Updated messages throughout the app to use more consistent, platform-neutral language.

highlights.title: Enter amounts in crypto or fiat
highlights.description: You can now type any amount in either the crypto amount or its fiat value, whichever is easier for you. The app converts it for you automatically.
highlights.howTo: When sending or requesting, tap the amount field and switch between crypto and your local currency.

highlights.title: Secure pending NIM in one tap
highlights.description: Got NIM waiting to be secured? Just tap your pending NIM on the home screen to lock it in right away instead of waiting.
highlights.howTo: On the Home screen, tap your pending NIM balance to secure it.

highlights.title: What's New in the app
highlights.description: See exactly what changed with each update. A friendly summary now appears after you update, with older release notes available anytime.

highlights.title: Smoother Mini Apps
highlights.description: Your most recently used Mini Apps now appear first, each app shows up only once, and opening them is faster and more reliable. Apps without an image now show a clean fallback icon.
highlights.howTo: Find your recent Mini Apps in the row at the bottom of the Home screen.

highlights.title: Reliability & polish
highlights.description: Faster PIN entry, more dependable incoming-payment notifications, a correct app icon on notifications, and "Withdraw All" now clears every last bit of NIM. Biometric login is also disabled when no PIN is set, for better security.

highlights.title: Fixed app stuck on PIN screen
highlights.description: Some users got stuck on the PIN screen after updating. The app now clears out the leftover data that caused this and opens normally.

highlights.title: More reliable startup
highlights.description: If the network has trouble loading when you open the app, Nimiq Pay now still unlocks and lets you in, then catches up on syncing afterward instead of freezing.
